text.en:
The name of a portion of the Schetelig Avenue, from corner Balagtas Boulevard to corner T.
Azucena and Barleta Streets, in the City of San Pablo is hereby changed to Maximino M. Magcase Street.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 12, 1982
